title: WorkFlow PH founded
body: Started as an initiative by Filipino tech volunteers to bridge the AI and automation literacy gap across both business and technical disciplines.

title: First Community Build Nights & Clinics
body: Launched hands-on problem-solving sessions connecting virtual assistants, developers, and solopreneurs with real cloud workflows.

title: Ecosystem partnerships established
body: Collaborations established with Tutorials Dojo, AWS User Group Philippines, and tech communities to expand hands-on training reach.

title: WorkFlow PH x Jia Talent Vault
body: Strategic partnership with Jia Talent Vault opening real-world automation project opportunities for community builders.

title: Echelon Philippines 2026
body: WorkFlow PH represents grassroots automation and AI talent alongside founders, investors, and enterprise innovators.

title: Public showcase platform ships
body: The community's record of workshops, open workflows, and volunteer contributors launches as a permanent public showcase.
